title: Flashcards: Where it is official, Europe
intro: Flip each card about Europe. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: In which country is Belarusian an official language?
cards.explain: Belarusian is an official language of Belarus.

cards.front: In which country is Bosnian an official language?
cards.explain: Bosnian is an official language of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

cards.front: In which country is Czech an official language?
cards.explain: Czech is an official language of Czechia.

cards.front: In which country is Danish an official language?
cards.explain: Danish is an official language of Denmark.

cards.front: In which country is Irish an official language?
cards.explain: Irish is an official language of Ireland.

cards.front: In which countries is Croatian an official language?
cards.explain: Croatian is an official language of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia.

cards.front: In which country is Icelandic an official language?
cards.explain: Icelandic is an official language of Iceland.

cards.front: In which country is Latvian an official language?
cards.explain: Latvian is an official language of Latvia.

cards.front: In which country is Lithuanian an official language?
cards.explain: Lithuanian is an official language of Lithuania.

cards.front: In which country is Slovak an official language?
cards.explain: Slovak is an official language of Slovakia.

cards.front: In which country is Slovenian an official language?
cards.explain: Slovenian is an official language of Slovenia.

cards.front: In which countries is Serbian an official language?
cards.explain: Serbian is an official language of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Serbia.
